clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, hunters prepare to face Whitemist in the northern Barrens. Sergra Darkthorn sends young Horde hunters to summon the legendary white lion and test their strength.

Across the central plains, a white-maned lion rules the savannah cats. Taur-ahe speakers call him Echeyakee, or Whitemist. Legend says he moves so silently that he seems like morning mist gliding over the red earth. His strikes come swiftly, leaving prey no time for fear or suffering. Local hunters revere him as a sign of mercy and swift death.

At the Crossroads, Sergra Darkthorn trains fledgling warriors. The experienced orc shaman sends her pupils to challenge the king of beasts after they have proven themselves against lesser savannah prowlers. With a special horn, you travel northeast past the mountain ridges to a graveyard of massive kodo bones. Sound the horn to challenge Echeyakee and draw the elusive predator from hiding for a test of strength and cunning.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Whitemist, Echeyakee in the Tauren tongue, is the king of the savannah cats. He hunts with such stealth, they say he's like a thin, white mist on the earth. And he kills so fast his prey have no time for fear, or pain.
The Tauren say he is both mercy and death.
You will learn if that's true, for I now set you on the path to hunt Echeyakee. His lair is northeast of the Crossroads, among the bones of giant Kodo
Go. Blow this horn when you reach his lair. Blow the horn, and he will come.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The great cat calls to you, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've beaten Echeyakee, and though his days of hunting are over... His spirit is with you. He will show you the strength found in subtlety, and the honor in mercy.
Your path is still long, adventurer. Let's hope you stride it well.
